title: Canonical poker analysis state
description: Versioned, surface-independent analysis-state object (poker-analysis-state/v1) shared by Review (Inbox/Dashboard), Replayer (Hero/opponent) and Training. The top-level `state` is the only user-facing label: exactly one of six explicit states is emitted per analysis subject. The technical dimensions are kept strictly separate so a single primary state never collapses distinct causes, and so a partial / non-comparable / pending / worker-error analysis can be represented without inventing a generic message. 'couverture' (coverage) must never be used as a primary user-facing label; it only survives as an internal generation dimension. An empty or placeholder dimension container (e.g. `ev_comparability:{}` or `recommendation_admissibility:{}`) is treated exactly like an absent dimension: the absence of evidence is never an evaluated negative conclusion, and `NOT_EVALUATED` remains an explicitly un-evaluated sentinel (never an optimistic value and never a synthesized blocking cause).

state.description: The six user-facing analysis states. Exactly one is emitted per analysis subject; detailed causes live in reason_codes and in the separated dimensions below.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable canonical codes explaining the emitted state and dimensions. Codes are stable identifiers, never display strings. Runtimes must preserve unknown/legacy codes verbatim; the canonical catalog is documented in $defs.reason_code. Detailed codes must be surfaced only in the secondary/technical view.

computational_status.description: Whether the deterministic computation actually finished. Kept separate from statistical support and from model support so that 'calcul non terminé' is never confused with a scientific cause. `NOT_EVALUATED` is the explicit fail-safe status used when the producer does not supply this dimension; it must never be replaced by `COMPLETE` without explicit positive evidence. An empty or placeholder container is not positive evidence, so this dimension stays `NOT_EVALUATED` until the producer supplies explicit evidence.

model_support_status.description: Whether the model can represent the requested context. Distinguishes 'absence de node' (the structural node/tree entry is missing) from 'contexte non supporté' (the node exists but the surrounding context is out of the supported domain). `NOT_EVALUATED` is the explicit fail-safe status when the producer does not supply this dimension.

statistical_support.description: Statistical support dimension, kept separate from computational and model support. observations counts raw matching observations; distinct_hands counts the distinct hands backing them so that one hand cannot masquerade as statistical support. `availability` is the explicit signal of whether this dimension was actually evaluated: AVAILABLE on a positive support, UNKNOWN when the producer supplied no support evidence (never a fabricated positive count) and UNAVAILABLE when the model cannot represent the support (absent node / unsupported context). The absence of a blocker must never be read as AVAILABLE.

availability.description: Explicit availability of the statistical-support dimension. Optional for backward compatibility with producers that predate the signal; a supplied value must use the explicit vocabulary.

ev_comparability.description: EV comparability dimension. `comparable` is true only when the played line and the recommendation are evaluated under the same admissible reference; `reason` names the blocking cause otherwise. When the producer supplies no comparability evidence, `comparable` is false and `reason` is `NOT_EVALUATED`; the mere absence of a blocker is never treated as comparability. An empty or placeholder container is not an evaluated negative: `comparable` stays false with `reason` `NOT_EVALUATED`, never a synthesized blocker, so `NOT_EVALUATED` remains explicitly un-evaluated. Never derived from support alone.

recommendation_admissibility.description: Recommendation admissibility dimension, kept separate from comparability and from model support. `admissible` is the sole gate guarding whether a Hero recommendation/EV may be exposed. When the producer supplies no admissibility evidence, `admissible` is false and `status` is `NOT_EVALUATED`; the absence of a blocker is never treated as admissibility. An empty or placeholder container is not an evaluated negative: `admissible` stays false with `status` `NOT_EVALUATED` and no synthesized blocking reason code, so `NOT_EVALUATED` remains explicitly un-evaluated.

posterior_availability.description: Availability state of the opponent/posterior range (#391 vocabulary), kept separate from Hero recommendation admissibility. `unavailable` covers the absence of any posterior (e.g. no node / unsupported context) and is also the fail-safe status when the producer supplies no posterior evidence; `conditioned` must never be inferred from the absence of a blocker.

error.description: Worker/calculation error dimension. `type` is null when no error occurred; a non-null `type` marks a worker error (ERREUR_CALCUL) and `retryable` states whether the same request may be retried safely.

reason_code.description: Canonical machine-readable reason codes covering the seven distinctions the taxonomy must keep separate. This catalog is informative and additive: runtimes may emit additional legacy codes, and must preserve unknown codes rather than dropping them or replacing them with a generic message. It is intentionally not a closed enum on `reason_codes.items` so forward/legacy codes stay valid.
